02 · Python

Orbital simulation

Two masses and Newton's law of gravitation. You type in the masses and the distance, it works out the force and draws the orbits.

force = G * m1 * m2 / distance**2
vel1[i] += force / m1 * d[i] / distance * dt
pos1[i] += vel1[i] * dt

PythonTkinterMatplotlib
